data.name: Ghazzal
data.gender_notes: Ghazzal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic lore, Ghazzal refers to the amoeba of light. It is believed that this creature was created from the light of God's revelation during the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) miraculous night journey to Jerusalem and then to the heavens. Ghazzal symbolizes purity, enlightenment, and closeness to the divine. The name Ghazzal carries the meaning “Amoeba of light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghazzal usually hope their child will grow to embody amoeba of light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ghazzal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Amoeba of light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghazzal total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
